digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center harness; inbound/outbound reconciler; rich-text codec
propositions: Live DC harness must assert rendered HTML via ?expand=renderedFields (not just wiki source) to verify Jira's interpretation of rich-text markup (bold, heading, code macros).
State-based echo-safety requires a second reconcile pass against the live instance to produce no description re-push when the landed rich body decodes to an unchanged value.

Both-sides concurrent edits (rebar-side AND Jira-side to description before next pass) must keep local rebar body and emit deduped outbound-field-conflict bridge alert with remote value recorded (not clobbered).
Inbound differ must normalize Jira's echoed wire form (via OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote) to recognize it as unchanged under DC rich-text codec, preventing spurious inbound updates.
Cross-repo contract test must pin normalize_rich_text signature and behavior so breaking changes in this package fail before agentic-dev-platform import breaks.
